Trip planning tools (14)

Free, interactive, no-signup tools that run right in your browser to help you plan every detail of your trip to Spain.

Trip budget calculator

Estimate your daily and total trip cost in yen and your home currency.

Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail fare & route finder

Compare bullet train travel times, unreserved/reserved/Green Car fares, and Rail Pass coverage across 38 major legs.

Rail Pass value helper

Compare the cost of individual long-distance train tickets against a nationwide Rail Pass.

Day-by-day itinerary builder

Build a custom 3-to-21-day Spain route by arrival airport, pace, and side trips, saved in your browser.

Spain phrasebook & allergy cards

40+ essential travel phrases and point-and-show dietary/allergy cards with Spain audio pronunciation.

Luggage & coin-locker size checker

Check if your suitcase needs a Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail oversized-baggage seat (160 cm rule), which station locker it fits, and Takkyubin shipping cost.

IC card vs transit pass calculator

Calculate how much to preload on Transit Card/Pasmo/Icoca and whether Madrid, Barcelona, Seville, Fukuoka, or Sapporo day passes pay off.

Spain jet lag & sleep planner

Get a personalized day-by-day light exposure, sleep-shift, and caffeine schedule for UTC+9 Spain Standard Time.

Etiquette & tipping quick-checker

Instant cheat-sheets for onsen, ryokan, temples, shrines, trains, escalators, and restaurants.

Plug & 100V voltage checker

Check if your chargers, CPAP, hair dryer, or straightener need an adapter or voltage converter on Spain's 100V 50/60Hz grid.

Seasonal calendar

Interactive month-by-month guide to weather, nature, festivals and crowds.

Packing list generator

Build a printable Spain packing checklist for your season, trip length and activities.

Yen converter

Convert between yen and your currency at a rate you set, with typical Spain prices.

Which region suits me?

Answer six quick questions to find the part of Spain that matches your travel style.
